_comment: Identical to the h_m01_size recovery config except sim_overrides pins
gamma_size_sd = 0, which fixes the TRUE slope at gamma_size_mean = 0. Data
are then simulated at a single, size-invariant true alpha and refitted.
The pass condition is that the estimator returns gamma_size ~ 0: the
reported bias for gamma_size should be within noise of zero and its
coverage should be near nominal. If it is not, a size slope measured in the
real study could be an artifact of choice-set geometry rather than
behavior, and RQ6 cannot be read behaviorally without a correction.
Because the true value is constant across iterations, the gamma_size
scatter plot degenerates to a vertical strip by construction. That is
expected here; the numbers to read are bias and coverage, not the plot.
A 3-replicate pilot at these settings gave posterior means +0.077, -0.035,
+0.062 (mean +0.035, SD 0.061) with all CIs covering zero, i.e. no
detectable bias. This config re-runs that properly as a recorded artefact.
